source_message: Achei ótimo. Se essas mudanças já estiverem bem documentadas para as próximas edições, podemos seguir para a portabilidade de toda minha participação como AGES II.
scope: visual presentation of the AGES I review candidate
reuse of the documented presentation pattern in subsequent AGES editions
authorization to proceed with AGES II once documented
limitations: This acceptance concerns the visual presentation and progression to AGES II; it does not identify image sources or supply missing diagrams.
It does not certify complete ABNT conformity or convert the review-only PDF into an official production build.
Known pending items remain recorded in docs/PENDENCIAS.md and docs/ages-i/CURRENT_REVIEW.md.
